statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The study is for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42
The service was denied under reason code CO-50
The denial was based on the service not meeting coverage criteria for medical necessity
